questions.question_english:
In case of transfer, if the family of the government servant travels to the new station 3 months after the employee has assumed charge, is the TA claim for the family admissible?
(A) No, family must travel along with the employee
(B) No, family must travel within 1 month of the transfer

options_english: No, family must travel along with the employee
No, family must travel within 1 month of the transfer
Yes, family members can travel within 6 months of the transfer order

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'c'. Under transfer Travelling Allowance rules, family members are not required to travel simultaneously with the official. key_facts: Family members can travel within six months of the transfer order.

questions.question_english: A School Principal is summoned to another state to attend an official consultative meeting. The Principal decides to travel two days early to visit relatives before the meeting. According to Travelling Allowance Rules, how should the Daily Allowance (DA) be calculated?
options_english: DA is admissible for the entire period of absence including personal visits from headquarters
DA is admissible only for meeting days and necessary transit time
DA is completely forfeited because personal leave was combined with the tour
DA is paid at a reduced rate of 50%
questions.explanation_english: Daily Allowance is strictly intended to cover expenses incurred while carrying out official duties away from headquarters. Combining private leave or personal visits with an official tour does not extend official entitlement. Therefore, Daily Allowance is admissible solely for the actual days spent attending the official meeting and the unavoidable transit time required for travel.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। दैनिक भत्ता मुख्यालय से दूर आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन करते समय होने वाले खर्चों को कवर करने के लिए है। व्यक्तिगत अवकाश या व्यक्तिगत यात्रा को आधिकारिक यात्रा के साथ जोड़ने से आधिकारिक अधिकार का विस्तार नहीं होता है। इसलिए, दैनिक भत्ता केवल आधिकारिक बैठक में भाग लेने के लिए व्यतीत किए गए वास्तविक दिनों और यात्रा के लिए आवश्यक अपरिहार्य पारगमन समय के लिए देय है।
key_facts: Daily Allowance is for official duties only.
Combining personal visits with official tours does not extend entitlement.
Printed answer key: (B) DA is admissible only for meeting days and necessary transit time.
